question: Who among the following launched the Ayushman Vay Vandana Card in Delhi in April 2025, along with Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hardeep Singh Puri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Hardeep Singh Puri is the Union Minister for Housing and Urban Affairs and has actively contributed to various government initiatives.
 
• He launched the Ayushman Vay Vandana Card in Delhi in April 2025, alongside Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta.
 
• The initiative focuses on providing benefits to senior citizens, ensuring their access to healthcare and social security.
 
• This launch aligns with the government's efforts to enhance welfare schemes for elderly citizens under the Ayushman Bharat framework.
 
• Hardeep Singh Puri has been instrumental in policy-making and implementation of urban development and welfare projects across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ayushman Bharat**: A flagship health insurance scheme aimed at providing financial protection for healthcare expenses to low-income families.
 
• **Senior Citizen Welfare Initiatives**: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card is part of India's broader efforts to provide healthcare access and social security to the elderly.
 
• **Hardeep Singh Puri's Role**: As a Union Minister, he has been involved in urban development, housing, and welfare schemes targeting multiple demographic groups.
 
• **Collaboration with State Governments**: The launch in Delhi highlights effective coordination between the central government and state leadership to implement welfare programs.
 
• **Ayushman Bharat Framework**: The initiative further strengthens the healthcare infrastructure in India, ensuring universal health coverage for vulnerable sections of society.
